name: MCP-B
notes: The monorepo holds the extension, a Cloudflare Workers backend and a native messaging host based on mcp-chrome; the extension chat needs an OpenAI or Anthropic key. Requires Node.js 22.12 or later and pnpm 10. License: AGPL-3.0.
summary: The earlier MCP-B codebase: a Chrome extension that discovers and calls tools websites expose as MCP servers, a Cloudflare Workers backend and a native server that relays those tools to desktop MCP clients.
